body.statement: Set \(v_\ell=\sqrt{n_\ell}(\widehat w_\ell-w_\ell)\), \(\epsilon_{t,\ell}=(\widehat Q_{1t,\ell}-Q_{1t,\ell},\ldots,\widehat Q_{Jt,\ell}-Q_{Jt,\ell})^\top\), \(D_{t,\ell}=D^{\mathrm{post}}_{t,\ell}\), and \(B_{t,\ell}=\sqrt{m_\ell}\int_0^1q_{t,\ell}(u)D_{t,\ell}(u)du\). For every finite array and every \(t>T_0\), the exact decomposition is \(E_{t,\ell}=m_\ell^{-1/2}\Psi^{\mathrm{fin}}_{t,\ell}+n_\ell^{-1}A_{t,\ell}(v_\ell)-2(n_\ell m_\ell)^{-1/2}v_\ell^\top B_{t,\ell}+n_\ell^{-1}\|v_\ell^\top\epsilon_{t,\ell}\|_{L^2}^2-2n_\ell^{-1/2}\langle D_{t,\ell},v_\ell^\top\epsilon_{t,\ell}\rangle+2n_\ell^{-1}\langle v_\ell^\top q_{t,\ell},v_\ell^\top\epsilon_{t,\ell}\rangle\). Uniformly over \(\mathcal M\) and jointly over post periods, each empirical quantile error is a bounded-height finite union of pulses whose total length is \(O_{\Pr}(m_\ell^{-1/2})\); therefore \(\|D_{t,\ell}\|_{L^1}=O_{\Pr}(m_\ell^{-1/2})\), \(B_{t,\ell}=O_{\Pr}(1)\), the displayed pre-weight--post-quantile cross term is \(O_{\Pr}(n_\ell^{-1/2}m_\ell^{-1/2})\), and the last three terms are respectively \(O_{\Pr}(n_\ell^{-1}m_\ell^{-1/2})\), \(O_{\Pr}(n_\ell^{-1/2}m_\ell^{-1/2})\), and \(O_{\Pr}(n_\ell^{-1}m_\ell^{-1/2})\). Hence \(r_{t,\ell}\) is their exact sum and \(\max_{t>T_0}|r_{t,\ell}|=O_{\Pr}(n_\ell^{-1/2}m_\ell^{-1/2}+n_\ell^{-1}m_\ell^{-1/2})=o_{\Pr}(a_\ell)\). No subsequential coordinate occurs in this finite-array identity.
body.justification: This exact algebra exposes every generated-weight term and uses finite-support pulse length to sharpen the pre-weight--post-quantile cross term to the order needed for all three phase laws.
body.gap: Chen's residual-matching DSC and Alvarez--Orestes's continuous-cell DSC inference do not derive a finite-support endpoint expansion with an estimated fixed-donor simplex weight; no formula-level comparison to Gunsilius Proposition~5 is asserted without verified version-of-record text.
body.consumer: It lets a study planner determine how pre-cell and post-cell replication control error in the identified post-treatment no-intervention quantile law.
